title: FICTIONAL demo: Larchbank Community Hall
brief: FICTIONAL DEMO PROJECT. Larchbank Community Trust (fictional) wants an early cost estimate for a new single-storey community hall on a cleared, level site near Perth, Scotland. The hall seats about 120 for events, with a kitchen, accessible toilets, a small meeting room and storage. Gross internal floor area about 300 m2. Traditional construction: concrete strip foundations and ground-bearing slab, timber frame, pitched roof with concrete tiles, rendered blockwork outer leaf. The Trust needs a budget figure to support a funding bid, excluding VAT, land and loose furniture. Use the specification and the room and finishes schedules attached.
